description: Routes a WPF application's missing Windows references to dependency setup rather than WinUI migration.
prompt: CS0234 on Windows.UI.Notifications in Larkspur Ledger after adding Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK. Is the target framework wrong, or am I missing a reference? We're keeping the WPF client and its MSI.

paraphrases.novice: The reminder code in Larkspur Ledger won't compile after we added Microsoft's library. Can you sort out what this WPF project needs to see those Windows classes?
paraphrases.terse: Larkspur WPF: CS0234 Windows.UI.Notifications after adding Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK. Fix references.
